title: Repeated symbols change their address
hook: The alphabet order changes after every symbol.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Prefix codes, strings, grammar productions and a stack.
doesNotKnow: Encode a symbol by its current list rank and move it to the front after each use.

misconception: A symbol's compressed code stays fixed throughout a message.
objective: Encode a symbol by its current list rank and move it to the front after each use.

claims.text: The code is the symbol’s rank in the current list. Moving a used symbol to the front changes later ranks, so recently repeated symbols acquire small codes. This transform needs a separate coding stage to turn ranks into compressed bits.
